items.title: Ro og orden · Sentrum (Tromsø)
items.author: Troms politidistrikt
items.body: Beruset gjest nektet å forlate festivalområdet. Nektet å oppgi personalia til patruljen. Innbrakt og innsatt i drukkenskapsarrest. Sak opprettes.

items.title: Perturbation Probing: A New Diagnostic for the Fragility of LLM Safety
items.author: Tony Li, Hongliang Liu and Yuhao Wu
items.body:
New research reveals that AI safety refusal lives in a thin neural layer, highlighting the critical need for external, multi-layered security.

The post Perturbation Probing: A New Diagnostic for the Fragility of LLM Safety appeared first on Unit 42.

items.title: Trying to make online friends to practice Norwegian with.
items.author: Voldi01
items.body: Hey everyone! How are you? I’ve been learning Norwegian for almost 2 years now and i feel like I’m ready to make conversations. So if anyone would like to help me practice my Norwegian skills, my dm’s are open. Thank you!
